title: Logistics & Supply Chain
completion_message: ¡Excelente trabajo! Ya conoces el vocabulario fundamental para gestionar la cadena de suministro y la logística.

parts.visual: Supply chain (Cadena de suministro): El proceso desde la creación hasta la entrega. Supplier (Proveedor). Warehouse (Almacén / Bodega). Inventory (Inventario).
parts.audio: Logistics and Supply chain. A Supplier is the company that provides materials. Warehouse is where we store goods. Inventory is the stock of products.

parts.visual: Transporte: Shipping (Envío). Delivery (Entrega). Track a package (Rastrear un paquete). Delay (Retraso). Freight (Flete / Carga).
parts.audio: Transportation. Shipping. Delivery. To track a package means to follow its location. Delay means the package is late. Freight refers to the cargo or goods.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra de logística correcta.

questions.question: We need to order more materials from our ____. (Proveedor).
The goods are stored in the ____. (Almacén/Bodega).
We need to check the ____. We might be out of stock. (Inventario).
The ____ is scheduled for tomorrow morning. (Entrega).
____ costs have increased this year. (De envío).
There is a ____ due to bad weather. (Retraso).
Can you give me the ____ number? (De rastreo).
The entire supply ____ was disrupted. (Cadena).
We transport heavy ____ by train. (Flete/Carga pesada).
The product is out of ____. (Agotado / Sin inventario).
We have plenty of items in ____. (En existencia / En inventario).
The ____ arrives at the port today. (Cargamento / Envío grande).
Who is responsible for the logistics and ____? (Distribución).
We use a ____ service for fast deliveries. (Servicio de mensajería rápida).
questions.explanation: Courier = mensajero o servicio de paquetería rápida (ej. FedEx, DHL).

questions.question: The goods are packed in wooden ____. (Cajas de madera/Huacales).
questions.explanation: Crates = cajas grandes de madera para transporte.

questions.question: Load the boxes onto the wooden ____. (Paleta / Tarima).
The truck driver will ____ the goods tomorrow. (Descargar).
questions.explanation: Unload = descargar (un camión/barco). Download es solo para internet.

questions.question: We need a forklift to ____ the truck. (Cargar).
questions.explanation: Load = cargar (físicamente). Upload es subir a internet.

questions.question: Customs clearance can cause a ____. (Retraso en aduanas).
questions.explanation: Customs clearance (despacho de aduanas) a menudo causa 'delays' (retrasos).

questions.question: Please sign the ____ note. (Nota de entrega/remisión).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el término correcto de la cadena de suministro.

questions.question: We buy from a local ____. (Proveedor)
It is stored in the ____. (Almacén)
We must check the ____. (Inventario)
The ____ is scheduled for Monday. (Entrega)
____ costs are high. (Costos de envío)
There is a ____. (Retraso)
What is the ____ number? (De rastreo)
Supply ____ management. (Cadena)
The item is out of ____. (Agotado)
We use a fast ____. (Servicio de mensajería - courier)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta sobre logística.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to order from our supplier.
options: We need to order from our supplier.
We need to call our supplier.
We must order from our supplier.
We need to buy from our supplier.
questions.correct_answer: We need to order from our supplier.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The goods are in the warehouse.
options: The goods are in the warehouse.
The boxes are in the warehouse.
The materials are in the warehouse.
The goods are stored in the warehouse.
questions.correct_answer: The goods are in the warehouse.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to check the inventory.
options: We need to check the inventory.
We have to check the inventory.
questions.correct_answer: We need to check the inventory.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The delivery is scheduled for tomorrow.
options: The delivery is scheduled for tomorrow.
The delivery is planned for tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: The delivery is scheduled for tomorrow.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: There is a delay due to bad weather.
options: There is a delay due to bad weather.
There is a delay because of the weather.
We have a delay due to bad weather.
The delay is due to bad weather.
questions.correct_answer: There is a delay due to bad weather.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Can you give me the tracking number?
options: Can you give me the tracking number?
Could you give me the tracking number?
Can I have the tracking number?
Please give me the tracking number.
questions.correct_answer: Can you give me the tracking number?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The product is out of stock.
options: The product is out of stock.
The item is out of stock.
The product is not in stock.
questions.correct_answer: The product is out of stock.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We use a courier service for fast deliveries.
options: We use a courier service for fast deliveries.
We use a courier for fast deliveries.
We have a courier service for fast deliveries.
I use a courier service for fast deliveries.
questions.correct_answer: We use a courier service for fast deliveries.
